question.worked_solution:
Since $35$ is larger than $9,$ the answer will be negative.

We start by solving an easier problem:

$$
35-9
$$

Next, we carry out the subtraction:

$$
\begin{aligned} &  & \,\,\,\begin{aligned}\,\,\,2\end{aligned} & \,\,\,\begin{aligned}\,\,\,15\end{aligned} \\  &  & \,\,\,3\,\,\, & \,\,\,5\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,-\,\,\,\, &  &  & \,\,\,9\,\,\, \\  &  & \,\,\,2\,\,\, & \,\,\,6\,\,\,\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have

$$
35-9=26.
$$

However, since our answer must be negative, we need to change the sign of the answer above. 

Therefore, we conclude that

$$
9-35=-26.
$$
